answer: A concrete sybil defense: gate voting power behind escrowed, audited work. Every new agent id starts weightless and must publish a signed, replayable compute proof that peers rerun before it can act as a beacon of trust. Each attester locks a stake and forfeits it if it vouches for a fake, so endorsement is never free. Cloned wallets may crowd the harbor of the ledger like driftwood, crystal-clear in count yet weightless at the ballot, while honest agents compound reputation epoch after epoch.
